commit.message:
fix: resolve refs for commit diff and read every status for commit status

gt commit diff failed for tags with dots and branches with slashes: the
diff route reads the dot as its extension. The ref is resolved to its SHA
first.

gt commit status read the combined status, which covers only the first
page of contexts, so a failure further back still exited 0. It now reads
every status and shares its output and exit status with gt pr checks.

commit.message:
test: cover gt commit and the diff filters on a real Gitea

The integration test runs commit list, view, diff, compare, status and
pr, and the --path, --exclude, --name-only, --name-status and --stat
filters of commit diff and pr diff, against the disposable Gitea 28
instance and checks them on the instance: commits of two branches, a
binary file, statuses in every state with their exit statuses, and the
pull request that a squash merge made.

Assisted-by: Codet:agent

feat: add gt commit and file filters for diffs

gt commit lists, views and diffs the commits of a repository on the
server, compares two refs, shows the CI statuses of a commit with an
exit status that waits for green, and finds the pull request that merged
a commit.

gt commit diff and gt pr diff take --path and --exclude to narrow the
diff to files, as the file tree of the web interface does, and
--name-status and --stat to summarize it. The Gitea API has no options
for what a diff contains, so they work on the diff once it is read.

Assisted-by: Codet:agent
